products.title: Shift and Pay Tracker spreadsheet
products.card_text: Log every shift. It adds weekend, public holiday and overtime rates, super, and flags underpayment.
products.summary: A spreadsheet for casual and part-time workers: type in each shift and it works out your hours, penalty rates, pay and super, checks your payslip, and warns student visa holders before they go over 48 hours a fortnight.
includes: A shift log for 400 shifts: date, start, finish and unpaid break. Weekends are detected for you, and overnight shifts work
Penalty rates for Saturday, Sunday, public holidays, evenings and overtime, for casual or permanent staff, set to your own award
Weekly totals of hours, gross pay and super (12%)
A payslip check: type what you were paid and it shows the difference in red if you were paid less
Student visa check: flags any Monday-start fortnight over 48 hours
Works in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. No macros, nothing to install
products.format: Excel file (.xlsx), also opens in Google Sheets, Numbers and LibreOffice
products.for_who: Casual and part-time workers in retail, hospitality, cleaning, aged care and similar jobs, and international students who need to watch their hours.
products.notice: This is a record-keeping tool, not legal or tax advice. It is only as accurate as the rates you enter, and awards have extra rules (minimum shift lengths, allowances, overtime triggers) that it does not cover. The penalty rates in it are examples to replace with your award's rates from the Fair Work Ombudsman. If you think you are underpaid, the Fair Work Ombudsman can help for free.
products.preview_note: Example: a casual on a $26.00 base rate. Rates shown are the example rates in the sheet; you set your own award's rates.
